text.en:
The name of the Sulu National Regional Agricultural School in the Municipality of Bongao,
Province of Tawi-Tawi, is hereby changed to Tawi-Tawi National Regional Agricultural School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 16, 1982
